title: Markov Chain CLTs: Resolving Open Problems
summary: Markov chain central limit theorems (CLTs) and their associated variances are very important for implementing Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms among other applications. Häggström and Rosenthal (2007) presented various results regarding the equality of different formulae for this variance and also posed seven open problems. We resolve all seven in this paper. For stationary, ergodic and reversible chains, we prove that whenever the normalized partial sums satisfy a $\sqrt{n}$-CLT, the variance limit is finite if the function is square-integrable, otherwise undefined.
